task.task_text: You are auditing a remittance ledger with two sections. The rate table lists rate codes and their unit rates. Each line item is one billed service; it gives either its own unit_rate or a rate_code whose unit rate is in the rate table. The amount owed for a line is qty x unit rate. A line is UNDERPAID when paid is less than the amount owed; its shortfall is (amount owed) - paid, in currency units with two decimals. Lines paid exactly, or overpaid, are not underpayments and must not be reported as underpaid. A claim is DUPLICATED when the same claim_id appears on more than one line item (billed more than once). Find every underpaid line and every duplicated claim.

Rows 11 to 70 are line items, with columns:
row,line_id,claim_id,qty,unit_rate,rate_code,paid
A line item gives either its own unit_rate or a rate_code defined in the rate table. A claim_id may appear on more than one line item.
You will not see the rows themselves.
task.fixed_sentence: This family is built so that splitting can hurt; its numbers show the autopsy detects split and context failures, not how often swarms lose in general.
